como_montar_o_prompt: Troque cada marcador {{NOME}} do prompt pelo texto do bloco de mesmo nome em 'blocos' (ESTILO, CENARIO, PROIBIDO, FOLHA_A, FOLHA_B, TEXTURA, TRANSICAO).

blocos.ESTILO: Dark fantasy pixel art in the exact style of the attached goblin reference sheet: high-detail hand-painted pixel art (late 16-bit / 32-bit era), crisp hard-edged pixels with no blur, no soft gradients and no anti-aliased glow; thick near-black outline (#1a1210) around every silhouette; strong chiaroscuro with light from the upper-left and deep shadows on the lower-right; earthy desaturated palette (olive, moss, rust, bone, peat brown, dark leather) with saturated color only on eyes, blood, poison and magic; gritty surface detail (scars, warts, grime, torn cloth, dried blood, moss); grim and menacing mood, never cute or cartoonish. Top-down 3/4 RPG camera like Tibia: we see the front and a little of the top of everything.
blocos.CENARIO: Setting: the Old Wood - an ancient temperate forest of huge oaks, beeches, birches and pines, sunlit clearings linked by dirt trails, a clear stream with wooden plank bridges, fallen mossy logs, and a ring of grey standing stones carved with spirals. Colors of the place: deep forest green, moss, bark brown, dry-leaf ochre, grey stone.
blocos.PROIBIDO: Do NOT include: background scenery, floor, cast shadow on the ground, text, labels, numbers, grid lines, frames, borders, watermark, signature, UI, or soft semi-transparent glow (draw glows as solid pixel rings).
blocos.FOLHA_A: SHEET: character turnaround sprite sheet on a fully transparent background (PNG with alpha), 2 rows x 6 columns = 12 figures of the SAME character, each figure completely separated from the others by empty transparent space (no overlap, nothing touching). Row 1: standing idle. Row 2: walking, mid-stride. Columns from left to right: (1) front view; (2) 3/4 front view turned to the LEFT; (3) side profile facing LEFT; (4) 3/4 back view turned to the LEFT; (5) back view; (6) 3/4 back view turned to the right. Same scale, outfit, colors and proportions in all figures. Aspect ratio 3:1.
blocos.FOLHA_B: SHEET: animation sprite sheet on a fully transparent background (PNG with alpha), 4 columns, one animation per row. EVERY figure is in side profile FACING LEFT. Each figure is completely separated from the others by empty transparent space. The frames of each row are consecutive frames of one animation, read left to right. Use the attached turnaround sheet of this same character as the model: identical design, colors and scale.
blocos.TEXTURA: SHEET: one seamless tileable ground texture, square 1024x1024, fully opaque, viewed straight from above (orthographic, no perspective, no horizon). It must tile perfectly on all four edges. Even lighting across the whole image (no vignette, no gradient); small details lit from the upper-left. Represents a 4x4 area of game tiles, so details are small: a pebble is ~20 px. No objects that stand up, no characters.
blocos.TRANSICAO: SHEET: one horizontal transition strip, 1536x512, fully opaque, viewed straight from above, seamless on the left and right edges. The top half is terrain A, the bottom half is terrain B, with a natural irregular border between them across the middle.
